INVASION fonctionne sans compte utilisat: INVASION works without a mandatory INVASION user account and without an INVASION game server. The Game Master’s device hosts the game on the local network.
Le jeu utilise votre pseudonyme, votre a: The game uses your nickname, appearance, technical identifiers and game information: roles, actions, votes and results. This data is stored locally, and necessary information is exchanged between participating devices. The Game Master has the information needed to administer the game. Network addresses and tokens support connections and reconnections.
Les sauvegardes servent à reprendre les: Saves let you resume games. Your chosen language and licence receipts are also stored on your device. Keys kept in the operating system’s protected storage help protect sensitive data and communications.

L’accès à la caméra est demandé pour sca: Camera access is requested to scan an invitation. The scanning flow does not save images or send them to the publisher. You can enter the invitation code manually without allowing camera access.
Les achats et restaurations de licence p: Licence purchases and restorations go through Apple or Google and require a connection to their services. The app uses transaction identifiers and receipts to verify entitlements, then keeps them in a protected cache. It does not receive your payment card number.
